newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens lower after Dow weakness.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens lower after Dow weakness.

text.p: The FTSE 100 started Friday's session weaker, tracking big losses on the Dow following London's close last night.
The index was 2.6 points off at 5,084.2 by 0742 GMT, having opened at 5,071.1. The Dow was 22 points higher at the London close but ended more than seventy points weaker.

However, the market is seen moving higher later as Thursday's upward momentum kicks in. The FTSE notched up closing and intra-day records on Thursday on the back of a quarter point rise in interest rates and comment from the Bank of England suggesting no further hikes in the current economic cycle.
